headline: A clear cost driver emerged in this window.

expiry_day_trading.why_it_matters: The expiry‑day trades accounted for a loss of ₹1,16,891. In the slice, 90 trades produced a loss of ₹1,16,891, an average loss of ₹1,299, a win rate of 29% and a 28% loss on average, while the rest of the trades (124) showed a 5% loss on average, a loss of ₹449 on average and a win rate of 37%.
expiry_day_trading.rule: Set a hard cap on expiry-day trades before the open.

closing: Consider applying the rule for expiry‑day trading next month.
